verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an incident-management SaaS like Rootly, but nothing in the evidence documents retention periods, deletion policies, or data-purge controls. The closest items are AI governance toggles (docs-82) and controlling which AI SRE memory notes are recalled (docs-85). Those are adjacent controls, not retention or deletion capabilities, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
